teaching.hint: Which properties of the consecutive equal-letter groups can the allowed extension change?

solution_outline.decisive_insight: Extensions preserve the ordered sequence of group letters; matching groups can remain equal or grow only to a target length of at least three.
solution_outline.approach: Compare maximal equal-letter runs of each word and s in lockstep. Reject different group letters or counts, any target run shorter than its query run, and any increase whose target length is only two.
solution_outline.state_and_invariant: After each matched run, all preceding groups have a legal independent transformation and both cursors are at the next group boundary.
solution_outline.correctness: Every extension affects only one run and cannot change group order. The per-run length condition is necessary and sufficient; applying it independently to every corresponding run yields s exactly.
solution_outline.complexity: O(W×|s| + total query length) time and O(1) auxiliary space, where W is the number of words.
solution_outline.pitfall: Allowing a one-letter run to grow to exactly two violates the operation’s minimum resulting run length.

common_wrong_turns: Allow growth to a final run of two
Accept when only one cursor reaches its end
source_fidelity_notes: Restated the extension operation precisely and kept a compact example for the length-two trap.
